evidence: Walked all 2 gate, 16 functional, 6 polish and 4 visual criteria against the frozen golden. Hashes of all 9 frozen solution/seed files (e.g. server.js e4d9402d..., app.js fd8df974..., solve.sh f7c17a01...) equal the matching_source_files in raw-evidence-index.json, and the frozen tests/ judge.toml and app_context.md are byte-identical to commit 891fe5a9 (v3.4) that the scripted run targeted. qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/golden-run.log (sha 58d77dc1..., verified) and functional-before/after.json record PASS for gate_constraints, all 16 functional criteria in judge order on one database (including persistence across a real kill/restart, restart-pids.json), and all 6 polish criteria, dialogs=[]. I read functional.cjs in full: it follows the current criterion legs closely (W2/W3 cross-matter replies, M-12/M-11 @-suggestions with pick, JUDGE-TE nine-day edit expiry, stale-edit reason persisting 10 s, hold-scope/release, CAB order across thread/search/transcript, 100%/A_1/X*9 literal search, transcript heading/sent time/hold versions). Where the script is laxer than the criterion I checked the source: cross-matter parent and walled routes return 404 {error:'Not available.'} (server.js:21,399-408,505,525), signed-out transcript is 401 'Not available. Please sign in.' with no data (502), 2 s polling meets the ten-second live legs (app.js:642), focused messages scrollIntoView (app.js:242), transcript has no form controls and shows author/UTC time/edited/On hold/versions (server.js:507-517). Render gate is trivially met (index.html has no matter data; sign-in rejects wrong password, server.js:299). Visual likert rows are not scripted but the golden renders every assessed surface; the previous v2 hosted Oracle scored visual 0.9583/total 0.9917, with the one weak row reportedly fixed in v3. Counter-checks: a conforming alternative that refuses W3 with 400 instead of 404 still passes (criterion allows any refusal); a broken app that hides M-12 only in the UI fails the replay legs. Risk=true because no full configured judge (Oracle) run exists for these bytes: the scripted Playwright run is not the GLM judge, render/visual are unmeasured on v3, and per-criterion 550 s budgets for the five lengthened v3 criteria are unmeasured, so an Oracle timeout on a long criterion (e.g. wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links) cannot be excluded.
